d:
Bihar men bahubli neta anant sinh ki beti ki shahi shadi in dinon charcha men hai. aise men anant sinh ne khud taiyariyon ko lekar jayja liya hai. pure lav lashkar ke sath ananti sinh apne paitrik ganv nadavan pahunche. is dauran unka kaphila aise aage ja raha tha jaise koee sauth ki muvi ki shuting chal rahi ho.
